classification_thresholds.A: one-to-one variant: pair precision >= 0.99, singleton false positives <= 1% of affected entities, macro F0.5 above the empty prediction
classification_thresholds.B: raw variant: pair recall >= 5% with mean candidates per entity <= 50
classification_thresholds.C: any rule that links pairs (its precision is the feature's likelihood)
